name: Unfortunate School Life
source:
Cole was taking a nice shower after his university gym class, but a thug took advantage of the situation and STOLE HIS CLOTHES! Now he's completely naked and exposed! Make the right decisions and help him escape back home with his dignity!

[From [url=https://freddykun.itch.io/unfortunate-school-life]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
上完大学体育课的科尔正舒舒服服地冲着澡，谁知一名恶棍趁虚而入，偷走了他的全部衣服！如今浑身赤裸、春光大泄的他进退两难！做出正确的抉择，帮他保住尊严平安逃回家吧！

[摘自[url=https://freddykun.itch.io/unfortunate-school-life]itch.io[/url]]
